Man arrested in Mumbai for distributing suspected poison capsules during Muharram

Mumbai police have arrested a man from Pune for allegedly distributing capsules containing rat poison during a Muharram procession. Authorities seized nearly 15,000 capsules. The accused reportedly claimed he intended to perform a 'noble deed' and aimed to harm a large number of people, though one outlet notes he claimed they were painkillers.
